a1-140.title: Communicative Challenge: Which Way?
a1-140.scenario: You (Meg) stand at a stop and phone Károly. You ask him which way the museum is. He tells you it is on the left, so you say that you understand and that you are going left.
a1-140.prompt: Ask Károly which way the museum is. He says it is on the left: say that you understand and that you are going left.
cues: Ask which way the museum is
Say you understand and that you go left
a1-140.target: Merre van a múzeum? Értem, balra megyek.
a1-140.english: Which way is the museum? I see, I am going left.
a1-140.canDo: I can ask the way and answer, like Merre van a múzeum? and Egyenesen.
